title: Delivery Tile Continuity
description: Four reference-linked delivery tiles establishing a consistent mobile-first food-commerce language.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the tile crop, card-safe hierarchy, packaging rhythm, and abstract badge system. Images 02-04 preserve that exact commerce layout while rotating meal format and offer emphasis.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-app-tile-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for the remaining series images. Queue may run the dependent variations concurrently after the reference is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
